en.tagline: Your Disney + Universal trip, perfectly timed
en.data_error: Could not load the data. Check the address in config.js.
en.offline: Offline: showing the last saved data.
en.notes_help: Up to 3 CSV files, multiple selection allowed, type detected from the header row: may_crowds (date,park,weekday,crowd_pct,note), ride_priorities (park,ride,avg_wait,avg_max_wait,tier), park_patterns (park,kind,key,crowd_pct). Kept only in this browser, never uploaded or published.
en.notes_loaded: {n} notes loaded ({ignored} ignored: rain, Memorial Day, Epic Universe opening; {invalid} unreadable).
en.notes_none: No notes imported: the calendar uses our statistics.
en.s_dates_help: First and last day in the parks.
en.dates_invalid: The end date must follow the start date (45 days max).
en.s_parks_help: How many times do you want to go to each park? (0 = not visited)
en.s_passes_help: Covered rides are counted with a shorter wait.
en.ll_multi_help: 3 bookings per day, given to the busiest rides.
en.ll_single_help: TRON, Guardians, Rise of the Resistance, Flight of Passage…
en.express_help: Express access on eligible rides (not Hagrid's).
en.s_pace_help: Number of rides, walking time and breaks.
en.pace_chill_d: ~6 rides, arrive 1 h after opening, long breaks.
en.pace_fast_d: ~16 rides, rope drop to close, no breaks.
en.s_forced_help: Dining reservation, special event, rest day…
en.s_must_help: Tick your must-dos: they get top priority.
en.surprise_help: We pick the rides for you based on your profile.
en.cal_help: One park per day, picked to dodge the crowds. Tap a day to see its plan.
en.rest_msg: Rest day: pool, Disney Springs, CityWalk…
en.estimate_note: Estimate: our records are still new, values get sharper every day.
en.legal: Personal project, not affiliated with Disney or Universal.
en.import_unknown: {file}: unknown file type (check the header row).
en.tier_A: Priority A: at opening or with a skip-the-line pass
en.tier_B: Priority B: early morning or evening
en.visits_limit: Limit reached: {max} visits at most ({days} trip days − {rest} fixed rest day(s)). Remove a visit elsewhere, add days or remove a rest day.
en.visits_reduced: Your dates or rest days changed: {n} visit(s) removed to fit in {max} days.
en.s_recap_help: Check your settings before creating your trip.
en.live_nodata: No live data for this park yet.
en.live_none_open: No open rides for these filters (park closed?).
en.live_hidden_cats: Shows and character meets are hidden: pick them in the filters to see them.
